title: Explanation Result v0.1 — draft for review
description: Only model-authored fields for an English-to-Chinese contextual explanation. The application owns capture, source, IDs, provider metadata and timestamps. Provider-specific structured-output compatibility still requires integration testing.

meaning.description: Concise Chinese meaning supported by the supplied context; state ambiguity when necessary.

sentenceTranslation.description: Chinese translation of the captured sentence derived from sentenceRange. Must be null when sentenceRange is null.

contextNote.description: Brief Chinese explanation grounded in captured text. May be empty when no useful explanation is supported.

limitations.description: Material ambiguity or missing-context limitations; empty when none need to be stated.
